gifts.title: Milk-check ticket so oat milk actually goes in the cup
gifts.for_complaint: Charged for alt milk, given regular
gifts.deliverable: A printable half-page order-verification card (PDF/HTML, print at home) listing Moxie's own milk options (whole, skim, oat, almond, coconut) and named specialty drinks as checkboxes. Barista circles the milk before handing off the cup, so the customer sees proof of what they paid for before walking away — a physical fix for the exact failure ('charged for alt milk, given regular, 5+ times') that turned a 4-star regular into a 1-star 'I can't go back.'
gifts.inputs_needed: Moxie Java's actual milk/modifier list and named drinks, pulled from their public menu at moxiejava.com.
gifts.why_they_stop_and_read: It quotes their own customer's exact words back at them — 'this has happened at least 5 times' — and hands over the fix already built, not a suggestion to train staff.

gifts.title: The punch card a regular already asked for
gifts.deliverable: A print-ready one-page punch card (10 stamps, buy-9-get-1 default) styled with Moxie Java's name and colors pulled from their own site — print on cardstock, cut, stack by the register today. No app, no Square account, no signup.
gifts.inputs_needed: Moxie Java's logo/color palette from moxiejava.com (public page, no login).
gifts.why_they_stop_and_read: It answers a specific customer who named their favorite drink (Milky Way) and asked for exactly this back in 2018 — the ask has been sitting unaddressed for eight years.

gifts.title: One card that shows every drink your regulars love
gifts.deliverable: A single printable counter card/poster compiling every drink customers named by name across their own reviews — Christmas Lace french vanilla mocha, Milky Way, Raspberry dessert coffee, caramel Frappuccino, s'mores blended, Americano — proving the menu isn't thin, it's just invisible at the counter.
gifts.inputs_needed: Confirming current names/availability against moxiejava.com's menu page (public, no login) to make sure nothing listed has been discontinued.
gifts.why_they_stop_and_read: Every drink on it is a real quote from their own customer, not a stock coffee-shop menu — it can't be handed to a different business.
